entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So, do you think Lavenza will[n]make it to the school?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I hope she doesn't get lost[n]or anything...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, don'tcha think it's a bad[n]idea, her wanderin' around in[n]that getup?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's true... Hopefully no one[n]gives her a hard time.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If someone does, you better[n]come up with a good excuse[n]for her, [fName]!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What'll you even say? Your[n]options're kinda limited as[n]a transfer student.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Just say she's your little sister[n]or somethin'.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wha—!? No, I'm not! How am I supposed[n]to pull something like that off?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A kitty helping out a little kid...[n]Sounds like one dynamite duo!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That could last three seasons[n]and a movie, easy!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's not exactly helpful to us[n]right now, though...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: At any rate, I'm certain she would[n]reach out to us if something were[n]to go awry.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's true—we can put our faith[n]in Lavenza.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Agreed. Let us know if anything[n]changes, [fName].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Why would Lady Lavenza want to meet up[n]at the school? It's not like she just wants to[n]check out the place... right?
